zh.headline: OpenAI 解散负责评估灾难性风险的 Preparedness 团队
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是**开源模型的快速追赶**：Qwen 3.8 27B 在社区实测中展现出逼近闭源旗舰的能力，配合 llama.cpp v0.1.0 的语义化版本发布，本地 Agent 工作流正在成为现实。与此同时，**算力基础设施的军备竞赛全面升级**——OpenAI 的俄亥俄州数据中心、Nvidia 对 SpaceX 和软银的双重投资、Groq 转型 neocloud，都指向同一个结论：模型层竞争正在向算力层和基础设施层转移。另一个不可忽视的趋势是**AI 安全治理的松动**：OpenAI 解散 Preparedness 团队、Anthropic 生物武器过滤器宕机近一年，这些事件叠加 Anthropic CEO 的"信任危机"论，说明行业在高速狂奔中对安全投入的优先级正在被重新审视。最后，Stripe 收购 OpenRouter 标志着 AI 模型分发正在成为支付巨头眼中的战略入口，Agent 经济的商业化基础设施正在成型。

items.value: 暴露前沿实验室安全基础设施的真实脆弱性。

en.headline: OpenAI disbands Preparedness team tasked with catching catastrophic AI risks
en.observation: The most notable signal today is the **tension between safety governance and commercial expansion**: OpenAI disbanding its Preparedness team and Anthropic's bio-weapons filter being down for nearly a year — both frontier labs' safety mechanisms exposed on the same day, while they sign multi-billion-dollar compute deals. Another clear trend is the **disconnect between benchmarks and real capability**: DeepSeek V4 Flash tops leaderboards but completes only 53.8% of real agent tasks, and Qwen 3.8 27B's community testing shows "overthinking" issues — developers increasingly need real-world evaluation over leaderboard scores. Finally, the open-source ecosystem continues to thrive: Qwen 3.8 27B approaches closed-source flagships on laptop-class hardware, DeepSeek released a plugin-based agent harness, and MiniMax open-sourced full music generation — the capability frontier of open models is expanding rapidly.
